summary: Bimergen Energy Corp via subsidiary Emergen Energy LLC contributed 100% equity in three BESS project companies to JV Company FPU-BEC Development Topco (Cerberus-affiliate) on May 21, 2026. Consideration: 75 Class B Units (7.5% of JV equity) plus $1,176,159 reimbursement payment. Two projects closed at signing; third closes within 15 days or Emergen makes capital contribution. The filing reports a completed asset contribution forming a joint venture, not a standalone acquisition or divestiture. Watch for project development milestones and potential additional capital calls under the JDA.
